[center][b][size=5]Characterization?[/size]
[size=3]A girl who likes to drink milk tea and drink food, but also has a little temper. I'm not very good at controlling characters because I'm not a professional screenwriter, I'm only good at drawing some costumes.[/size]

[size=5]Qingfeng's compatibility?[/size]
[size=3]Compatible with the three major expansions, SVE RSV ES , as for those NPCs in East Scarp that need to be added later, I predict that they are all compatible, if there are any bugs welcome to submit at any time.[/size][/b]
[size=3][b]I'm not a professional coder, but that doesn't mean I can't fix bugs, and I know a lot of people who can, and I've done multiple tests. 
[/b][/size]
[b][size=5]What are the gift preferences and event triggers?[/size]
[size=3]Find out easily with Lookup Anything and Event Lookup.
[/size]
[size=5]Where do NPCs live?[/size]
[size=3]There's an opening in the top right corner of the JojaMart, so just go in and find it, and it's home the vast majority of the time.
[/size][/b]
[size=5][b]Festivals stand in conflict?[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]It seems I can't quite fix the conflict with other NPC locations in the festival, although it doesn't cause the game to crash. But you can change it manually. The location is in [CP]Qingfeng/data/Festivals. Open it and look for (e.g. Egg Festivals) “Value”: “Qingfeng 45 57 0”, change the coordinates in it. 0 for facing up, 1 for facing right, 2 for facing down, and 3 for facing left.[/b][/size]

[b][center][size=5][b]人物性格？
[/b][/size][/center][size=3][center][b]一位喜欢喝奶茶喝吃东西的女生，又是会撒些小脾气。对于人物性格的把控我不是很擅长，因为我并不是专业的编剧一类的人物，我只擅长画一些服饰。[/b][/center][/size]
[/b][center][b][size=5]李清枫的兼容性？

[/size][/b][size=3][b]兼容三大拓展，SVE 里奇赛德 东斯卡普 ，至于东斯那些需要后加的NPC，我预估是全部兼容的，如果有任何BUG欢迎随时提交。
我不是专业的码师，但这不代表我不会修BUG，而且我认识很多会修BUG的人，并且我已经进行多次测试。（开心）[/b][/size]

[b][size=5]礼物喜好和事件触发条件是什么？
[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]使用[/size][size=4] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url][/size] [size=3] 和 [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505][size=4]Event Lookup[/size][/url] [size=3] [/size][/b][size=3][b]可以轻松查找。[/b]

[/size][b][size=5]NPC住在哪里？
[/size][/b]
[size=3][b]joja超市右上角开了个口子，进去就可以找到了，而且绝大数时间都是在家。[/b][/size]

[b][size=5]如何解决节日站位冲突？[/size][/b]

[b][size=3]看来我无法完全解决在节日中与其他NPC位置的冲突，虽然这不会导致游戏崩溃。但是你可以手动修改。位置在[CP]Qingfeng/data/Festivals中。打开并寻找（例如彩蛋节）  "Value": "Qingfeng 45 57 0",中修改坐标。[/size][/b][size=3][b]0代表朝向上，1代表向右，2代表朝下，3代表向左。[/b][/size][b][size=5]
